body:
I have added a delightful and accessible tooltip helper to the "Start" buttons of pending tasks in `TaskSequencer.tsx`. This tells the user exactly what will happen when they click the button: starting the task and changing active focus. I've also updated the unit tests and successfully verified the frontend visually with Playwright.

---
*PR created automatically by Jules for task [15106166164638501174](https://jules.google.com/task/15106166164638501174) started by @hu3mann*

commits.messageBody:
Wrapped the "Start" buttons of pending, non-current tasks in TaskSequencer.tsx with a Material UI Tooltip to provide precise contextual hover/focus feedback. This complements the existing ARIA label to improve keyboard focus and screen reader visibility, reducing tooltip fighting and matching the established micro-UX patterns. Updated Accessibility.test.tsx with regex assertions to verify the presence and content of the tooltip.
